definitionZh: QSlideTransition Vue 组件根据封装元素的可见性向上或向下滑动。与 v-show 和 v-if 一起使用。
sourceDefinition: The QSlideTransition Vue component slides the encapsulated element up or down, based on its visibility. Works alongside v-show and v-if.
